# rnd

Mine patterns, benchmark the engine, sync upstream and convert textbooks.

Request: $ARGUMENTS — if it names a repo (kun · catalog · codebase), add `--repo <repo>` to every station call below.

1. **No request** — run `node ~/kun/.claude/scripts/station.mjs board --dept rnd [--repo <repo>] --json` and show its up-to-three options (`label_en` / `label_ar`, `why`). The person taps one or types text.
2. **A request** — run `node ~/kun/.claude/scripts/station.mjs match "<text>" --dept rnd [--repo <repo>] --json`.
   - It names a formula (`id`): run `node ~/kun/.claude/scripts/station.mjs fill <id> --dept rnd [--repo <repo>] --json`, show the filled `prompt`, ask for anything in `missing`, then hand it to the `rnd` agent on the `route` the fill returns.
   - `id` is null: no formula fits. Hand the request to the `rnd` agent in the department's frame (`departments/rnd/pack.json` → `formula.en`: Task · Context · References · Constraints · Deliverable).
3. The agent plans and judges; building goes to cheaper lanes with a written brief. It stops at every human gate and never approves.

Tools of the department: `/learn` · `/bench` · `/sync` · `/textbook` · `/convert` · the `rnd` agent.
